name: main-red-unfreeze
about: #197: after a merges, b's PR fails CI and land sends b back to build; then main's CI on a's merge is red, still red after a re-run: the repo freezes and the runner claims nothing (b is frozen, the P1 waits in intake: this runner does no triage). The user lifts the freeze by hand (loop unfreeze sandbox/demo): b's CI failed while main was red, so it goes back to build with "main was red; rebase and re-run", and its next build is claimed with that note in its brief.

run_files.text: - CI failed on PR #102 while `main` was red; `main` is green now\. Merge `main` into this branch .*loopd's note is in `\.loop/review/held\.md`\.\n

messages.text: ^Back to build: main was red; rebase and re-run \(CI failed on this PR while main was red; main is green now\)\.$
^:large_green_circle: \*sandbox/demo unfrozen\* \(lifted by hand\)\. CI failed on these while main was red, so they go back to build to rebase and re-run: #2 Tidy the digest footer\.$
